body.html: Ramiarndao Boutique Place is a small boutique hotel of around 20 rooms at Moo 18, Tambon Bung, in Mueang Amnat Charoen district · What sets it apart from the in-town hotels is its location among the rice fields, which gives it a calm, quiet feel, with a garden and terrace to sit out on — ideal for anyone who wants to rest without the bustle.

There are several room types, from a Standard Double with a big bed to a garden-view Standard Twin and a Standard Triple for small groups (around 22–26 sq.m.) · What guests consistently praise is that rooms are clean, beds are soft and comfortable, the air-con is cold and it's quiet at night · Every room has air-conditioning, a fridge, TV, en-suite bathroom and free Wi-Fi · Everything works as it should, with simple boutique styling that fits the mid-hundreds price point.
"Clean room, very quiet, you wake up to green rice fields and lovely surroundings · Breakfast included, friendly staff, safe parking — great value at this price."

The atmosphere is what guests love most · The hotel sits among rice fields, with a garden and terrace to sip your morning coffee, where you can hear birds and the wind crossing the paddies · It suits anyone who wants to escape the noise for a quiet stay · It's in Tambon Bung, near Phra Mongkol Ming Mueang Buddha Park (the great Buddha of Amnat Charoen), about a 5-minute drive, with the town centre also a short hop away.

On facilities, it offers more than you'd expect at this price · There's free breakfast, a garden, terrace, restaurant and bicycles to borrow · There's a small fitness corner, free secure parking, a 24-hour front desk so late check-ins are fine, and it's pet-friendly · Staff earn praise for being friendly, attentive and able to communicate in English — handy for both Thai and international travellers passing through.

To be straight with you, per real reviews: this is a small 3-star boutique hotel, not a luxury resort · It sits out among the rice fields, fairly far from the town centre, so anyone wanting to walk to the clock tower or night market will need to drive or grab a ride, and shops nearby are still few · Some reviews mention soft water pressure in certain rooms and towels that could be kept fresher — all part of the trade-off for the quiet and the gentle price.

In short, if you want a stay in Amnat Charoen that's quiet, atmospheric, with rice-field views and a garden to relax in, at a price that's still reachable — Ramiarndao Boutique Place fits the bill · A score of around 8.2 from over 126 reviews on Agoda reflects a good-atmosphere, good-value stay · It suits couples after a peaceful night, self-drivers, or anyone visiting the Buddha park who wants to sleep nearby.

A tip from following the reviews here: if you love the setting, ask for a room facing the garden or the fields for the full view and quiet · Driving yourself is easiest since it's outside town with few shops around · And if you want to pay respects, Phra Mongkol Ming Mueang Buddha Park is close — an easy drive, ideal to stop by in the morning before heading on.

honestSummary: Ramiarndao Boutique Place is the best pick for anyone who wants a boutique hotel in Amnat Charoen that's quiet and atmospheric, with rice-field views and a garden, at a price that's still gentle — with free breakfast and safe parking · You just have to accept it's out of town among the fields, and facilities are small-scale rather than resort-sized.
honestChecks: If you want to walk to the clock tower or night market in the centre — this is out among the fields, so you'll need to drive or grab a ride → for a walkable base, look at Faikid Hotel or LJ The Emerald in the centre.

If you expect a big resort with a pool and full facilities — this is a small boutique focused on quiet and clean rooms, with no pool → if you want a pool, consider an edge-of-town option like Penpit Hotel.
If you love peace and quiet and are driving yourself — this delivers on rice-field atmosphere and safe parking → book or call to check availability ahead, as it's a small ~20-room property.

faqTitle: Frequently Asked Questions — Ramiarndao Boutique Place, Amnat Charoen

faq.q: Where is Ramiarndao Boutique Place in Amnat Charoen, and what's nearby?
faq.a: Ramiarndao Boutique Place is at 151-153 Moo 18, Tambon Bung, Mueang Amnat Charoen, set among rice fields · It's near Phra Mongkol Ming Mueang Buddha Park (~3 km · about 5 min drive), and the town centre, clock tower and night market are about 6–8 minutes' drive away · The surroundings are quiet, with few shops nearby.

faq.q: What's the starting price at Ramiarndao Boutique Place, and what rooms are there?
faq.a: Prices start from approximately ฿650/night for a Standard Double · There are also a garden-view Standard Twin, a Standard Triple and a Deluxe (around 22–26 sq.m.) at roughly ฿700–฿950 · Prices vary by room type and season, so compare Agoda and Trip.com before booking.

faq.q: Does Ramiarndao Boutique Place have breakfast and parking?
faq.a: Yes — there's free breakfast and free, secure parking · It also has a garden, terrace, restaurant and bicycles to borrow · The front desk is open 24 hours so late check-ins are fine, and it's pet-friendly (ask first).

faq.q: Who is Ramiarndao Boutique Place best for?
faq.a: It's best for anyone wanting a quiet, atmospheric stay in Amnat Charoen with rice-field views at a gentle price · It suits couples, self-drivers, or visitors to the Buddha park who want to sleep nearby · It's less suited to those who want to walk around the town centre or need a big resort with a pool.

faq.q: Are the rooms at Ramiarndao Boutique Place clean and quiet?
faq.a: Most real reviews say rooms are clean, beds are soft, and it's very quiet thanks to the rice-field setting · You wake to green views and a lovely atmosphere · Some reviews note soft water pressure in certain rooms and towels that could be fresher, but overall cleanliness is good for this price.

faq.q: Is Ramiarndao Boutique Place convenient if I'm driving myself?
faq.a: Yes · The hotel has free, secure parking · Since it's outside town among the fields with few shops around, driving yourself is easiest · Tambon Bung is a short drive from the town centre, and Phra Mongkol Ming Mueang Buddha Park is close by for a visit.
